Accommodations for Applicants with Disabilities, etc.
・Accommodations for Applicants with Disabilities, etc.
・Foreign Language (TOEFL) examination for persons with disabilities
If applicants with disabilities are planning to apply, TOEFL testing accommodations will be provided by ETS. Applicants are requested to contact ETS in advance, take the TOEFL with the necessary accommodations according to the instructions, and obtain a score prior to application. This score may then be used when applying.
Please note that all documents required for requesting testing accommodations from ETS must be prepared in English.
Although ETS indicates that the review of accommodation requests may take approximately six weeks, the review process may require a longer period in practice.
In addition, after approval has been granted, securing a test appointment may also take a considerable amount of time.Applicants are therefore strongly encouraged to begin the necessary procedures well in advance.
To contact ETS regarding testing accommodations, applicants are advised to log in to the ETS account portal, “My TOEFL Home”, and use the “Accommodations” option available from the menu on the left-hand side of the screen.
